notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Added easier sticks control mode. Sticks mode can be changed in game settings in main menu.
More clear instructions in some quests.
Game stability improved.

notes.title: THE NEW UPDATE IS LIVE
notes.content:
Hey, y'all! 

The Update is live, and you can check it out right away. 

Meet the New tutorial island with new quests and activities.
Also, the game got a bunch of minor improvements and fixes!

And, here comes not so tiny discount - 66% off the price!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41163597/1cc0afdaf67692d4a638da032e836a919dd0caa6.gif

And don't forget to leave tiny feedback at our communities on Steam, Discord, and Twitter^^

notes.title: THE UPDATE DELAY
notes.content:
Hey, y'all! 

We decided to move our new update release for one week in an effort to deliver the best experience to the  players

notes.title: NEW UPDATE
notes.content:
Hey, y'all!

We have a piece of fantastic news! 

The new update is coming up and will be available on the 14th of April! 

The big thing about it is the brand-new tutorial; we hope you love it. Also, there will be a bunch of tiny improvements and fixes. So don’t miss it ^^
